payout_quote: Once your item is received at our warehouse and processed, payment will be issued within 14 business days. Valore currently supports two methods of payment: Check: Once a check has been issued, you can expect to receive your payment within 7-14 business days. ... Paypal: Once issued, PayPal payments typically post to your account within 2-14 business days.
timing: Payment issued within 14 business days of warehouse processing; check arrives 7-14 business days via USPS, PayPal posts 2-14 business days.
eligibility: Anyone with eligible textbooks; Valore does not accept international, teacher/annotated instructor's, or sample editions; books must meet minimum condition requirements.
catches: Payout varies per book, edition, condition, and demand — the $200 headline is unsupported; many books quote far less.
Books must be shipped within 7 days of the quote; prepaid labels expire after 10 days.
If the book's condition doesn't match your description, the quote can be revised down.
Full cycle (quote, ship, warehouse evaluation, payment) takes weeks.

weasel_words.quote: No fixed dollar amount on the official site — '$200' is an unsupported headline; quotes are per-book.

steps: Go to https://www.valore.com/sellback and enter your textbook's ISBN to get a sellback quote.
Accept the quote if the price works for you (quotes vary per book and condition).
Use Valore's prepaid shipping label and ship the book within 7 days of receiving the quote.
Valore's warehouse receives and evaluates the book against your stated condition.
Payment is issued within 14 business days of warehouse processing.
Receive payment by check (USPS, 7-14 business days) or PayPal (2-14 business days).
biggest_catch: Your payout is whatever Valore quotes for your specific book — the $200 headline is fiction; most textbooks quote well under that, and the full cycle takes weeks.
notes: Verified on official sellback terms. Route's $200 claim unsupported. ValoreBooks has rebranded to valore.com (chegg-website referral confirms the move).
